lessons.claim: Having counted the drawn particles exactly does not mean 'that is the simulation's N'. The intake/network sketch drew 21 circles countably, but the topology is a tree (20 links, 0 independent loops, 6/21 free ends). The goals are G'(ω) and stress propagation = bulk/ensemble quantities, and a tree has no closed path to carry stress so G'(ω→0)→0 and the goal is not defined. The criterion is not 'was it countable' but 'is the target observable defined at that N' -- if it is not, the drawing is a schematic and N has to be proposed separately at the size the observable requires.

not_verified: the verdict that the drawing is a schematic is itself an inference (the A6 lean). The possibility remains that the user intended 'the 21 as drawn, a tree', in which case this case becomes a repetition of the chain-bend-2d-dlvo conclusion.
